acceptanceCriteria: An unambiguous abbreviated SHA given to --base resolves to and reports the full SHA; an ambiguous prefix refuses with a named code.
--root after the verb is accepted with the same meaning as before it, or refused with a message naming the correct position.
body: Observed 2026-10-11 by the V1-0040 slice-2 lane (branch claude/v1-0040-slice2, Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 456). Expected: `corvint affected --base <short-sha>` resolves an unambiguous abbreviated commit the way git does, and `--root DIR` works after the verb as well as before it. Actual: a short SHA is refused (a full 40-hex SHA is required) and `corvint affected --root DIR ...` fails unless `--root` precedes the verb. Both cost a retry in every lane. Keep exactness: the resolved full SHA must be what is pinned in output; an ambiguous prefix must refuse.
title: cli: `corvint affected --base` refuses an abbreviated SHA and `--root` is accepted only before the verb
